name: Aubergine Kitchen (Orem & Lehi, UT) Warm Mediterranean Chicken & Rice Bowl
whyItWorks: Clean, anti-inflammatory Mediterranean cooking! Grilled antibiotic-free chicken breast, turmeric brown rice, roasted sweet potato cubes, and smooth hummus. Zero refined seed oils or artificial additives.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Warm Chicken Bowl with brown rice, roasted sweet potatoes, and hummus (hold raw cabbage, raw onions, and spicy tahini).
watchOuts: Hold raw cabbage and pickled onions
